title: Mr C Residences pattern
description: A flat decorative panel filled with a fine lattice of interlocking 1px circles in the theme's highlight colour (or a faint tint of the text colour), drawn with CSS gradients only. It fills whatever box it is given.
notes: size it from outside (absolute inset-0, a fixed height, a grid cell)
tone 'line' uses --highlight; tone 'faint' uses about 20% of --primary-foreground, for use on a primary band
the cell is 26px on phones and 38px from 1024px
